rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a turtle or tortoise in casual Hong Kong Cantonese.

example.english: I kept a turtle when I was little.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 joeng5 gwo3 jat1 zek3 wu1 gwai1

rows.note: Use this shorter form in compounds, names, or when the context already makes the animal clear.

example.jyutping: nei1 zek3 gwai1 jau4 dak1 hou2 faai3
